before.method: Independent Blender source-ID depth render vs real native diagnostic MOC, original texture alpha retained. 1px tolerance (far: 3px), visible reference face with interior eye/mouth holes filled then dilated 5px as ROI. Pixel counts include projection/interpolation errors; small islands count connected leak components <=16px; finite coverage is not a proof for all real-valued poses.

after.method: Independent Blender source-ID depth render vs real native diagnostic MOC, original texture alpha retained. 1px tolerance (far: 3px), visible reference face with interior eye/mouth holes filled then dilated 5px as ROI. Pixel counts include projection/interpolation errors; small islands count connected leak components <=16px; finite coverage is not a proof for all real-valued poses.

native_glue.method: Independent IR scalar-grid interpolation and ordered barycentric lerps compared with actual pinned Ayagami-evaluated MOC vertices, after original source welds

config.method: Source-depth conflict screening across the entire 105-pose head grid selects curved hair patches for native tracked planar subdivision. All source head hair and skin participate in depth masks.

mask_unions.method: Exact opaque alpha union with original winding and post-evaluation master corner Glue; <=60000 vertices per native ArtMesh

teeth.method: Source-connected tracked teeth, fixed oral hierarchy with expression-dependent 3D inverse depth masks

mouth_aperture.method: Exact opaque alpha union with original winding and post-evaluation master corner Glue; <=60000 vertices per native ArtMesh

packed_sources.reason: Full-source packing increases motion-update work and model size; keep only the shared inherited unions.

scalar_compression.method: Remove invariant/redundant axes and keys using source-master pose diameter, parent Warp Lipschitz and a weld allowance. At most two variable lerps per mask vertex; verify actual native displacement over the regression cohort.

scalar_grid_compression.method: Remove invariant/redundant axes and keys using source-master pose diameter, parent Warp Lipschitz and a weld allowance. At most two variable lerps per mask vertex; verify actual native displacement over the regression cohort.

before.method: Native diagnostic MOC with source eye/sclera, face-skin and headwear IDs versus an independent Blender depth-rendered pass, original alpha retained, 1px boundary tolerance. Includes projection interpolation error.

after.method: Native diagnostic MOC with source eye/sclera, face-skin and headwear IDs versus an independent Blender depth-rendered pass, original alpha retained, 1px boundary tolerance. Includes projection interpolation error.

before.method: Native skin-ID MOC versus independent Blender source depth pass, projected original neck bounds +5px ROI, 1px boundary tolerance; includes projection and support-plane approximation error.

after.method: Native skin-ID MOC versus independent Blender source depth pass, projected original neck bounds +5px ROI, 1px boundary tolerance; includes projection and support-plane approximation error.

limitations: Finite source sampling and local support-plane approximations cannot certify every real-valued parameter combination.
Image metrics also contain source silhouette, projection, interpolation and the prior Blender hair-clearance approximation errors.
This release updates the quality MOC only. Prior CMO3 projects do not contain this repair; official Cubism Editor compatibility is not claimed.

before.method: POPY-specific white texture threshold minRGB>=248, saturation<=7 and alpha>200 inside an independent Blender projection of the actual original tooth vertices, padded 2px; 1px boundary tolerance. Additional proxy only; nearby white surfaces can confound it.

after.method: POPY-specific white texture threshold minRGB>=248, saturation<=7 and alpha>200 inside an independent Blender projection of the actual original tooth vertices, padded 2px; 1px boundary tolerance. Additional proxy only; nearby white surfaces can confound it.

before.method: Actual Blender tooth source-ID depth pass versus real diagnostic MOC red channel, original alpha retained, 1px boundary tolerance (far: 3px); no white-texture threshold or projected ROI.

after.method: Actual Blender tooth source-ID depth pass versus real diagnostic MOC red channel, original alpha retained, 1px boundary tolerance (far: 3px); no white-texture threshold or projected ROI.

source_reproduction.method: Full independent regeneration from the collar baseline with the final default config, followed by a real runtime-only Cubism export; promoted this source-generated version and reran the image regression. No claim of byte equivalence to earlier hand-staged prototypes.

Pixel counts include projection/interpolation errors; small islands count connected leak components <=16px; finite coverage is not a proof for all real-valued poses.
